title: Nostalgic Kenyan Mushroom Pilaf
description: This earthy and chewy dish is a nostalgic Kenyan favorite, featuring mushrooms and a flavorful tadka, made in a large paella pan.
instructions: Heat the ghee or oil in a large paella pan over medium heat.
Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the coriander powder, turmeric powder, and salt, and stir well.
Add the basmati rice and stir to coat the rice with the spice mixture.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the liquid is absorbed.
Turn off the heat and let the pilaf rest for 5 minutes before serving.
